svg.title: Version J: two-floor study with updated upstairs image trace
svg.desc: November 9, 2026. The complete downstairs panel and chart are retained from Version I. Only the upstairs panel is redrawn from the owner's new plan image; Version J is SVG-only and does not change the active Version H upstairs 3D model or saved layouts. Both panels use feet at 12 SVG pixels per foot. Upstairs raster calibration is 216 source pixels for the labelled 14 feet 8 inches primary-bedroom width; other printed dimensions do not fully reconcile. Source dimension strings are labels, not measured clear sizes. Downstairs area remains 1,924.33 square feet including the actual stair. Approximate upstairs trace is 1,982.77 square feet including a 35.27-square-foot outward wall allowance and excluding the 89.60-square-foot pictured stair block; combined trace estimate is 3,907.10 square feet. Areas are comparisons, not certified finished or usable areas. Version H remains the active upstairs layout, with live upstairs and combined model estimates of 2,020.76 and 3,945.10 square feet. The image trace adds no unpictured furniture, fixtures or openings. Structure, support, products, egress and operation remain unverified. Saved layout JSON is unchanged.
svg.text: Combined trace: ~3,907.10 sq ft | stairs once downstairs | Version H remains active in 3D
North / rear at top. Both panels: 12 SVG pixels = 1 foot. Version J revises only the upstairs image trace.
1,924.33 sq ft | includes stairs | kids 144.59 sq ft

svg.metadata: Upstairs image trace uses source pixels calibrated from 216 pixels for 14 feet 8 inches. Room rectangles tile the orthogonal exterior-centerline outline except the pictured stair block. The upstairs total adds the outward half-wall bands and corners for nominal .35-foot walls. Ground uses the shared model area helper including actual stairs. Garage, porch and basement excluded. Source dimensions do not fully reconcile; not certified finished or usable area.

g.text: Room-boundary / centerline areas, not clear usable floor area. Upstairs values are image-trace estimates.
Wall figures are horizontal footprint, NOT vertical wall surface area or the whole wall footprint.
Interior walls and inward exterior-wall portions are already within the room allocations; do not add them again.
Downstairs: nominal 5.4-inch exterior walls / generally 4.2-inch garage separation. Upstairs: drawn 4.2-inch walls.
Wall assemblies are assumptions. Source-image dimensions do not fully reconcile; hundredths are arithmetic precision only.
Stairs count downstairs only: 75.49 sq ft net. The traced 89.60-sq-ft upstairs stair block is excluded.
Garage, porch and basement excluded. Egress, headroom, access and structure unverified; not certified area.
Version H remains the active 3D plan; Version J is an image-trace study. Saved layouts are unchanged.
